name: print-social-mega-fashion-sale-post-with-magenta-panel-and-dual-photos
title: 'Mega Fashion Sale' post with a magenta-to-purple panel and two rounded photos in yellow
whatItIs: A square white post with a magenta-to-purple gradient panel holding a script 'Mega', 'FASHION' and yellow 'SALE', a yellow 'Shop now' button, and two overlapping rounded photos of a man in a yellow jacket framed by a tilted yellow shape.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and energetic; the yellow jacket and frame tie product to brand colour.
techniques: Pair a small and large photo of the same model.
Frame photos with a tilted accent shape.
Use a gradient panel for text.

vocabulary.definition: Two photos of one subject at different scales.
A coloured shape behind a photo.
